description: Takes a tag off Riddles - ONE assignment per Riddle (riddle_tag_add puts it on, riddle_tag_delete removes a label nothing carries). Untags one Riddle (UUID) or many (UUIDs, max 100), by tagName or tagId, and creates nothing: a tag the Riddle or its project does not have is an error for that Riddle. Untagging the LAST carrier deletes the tag itself from the project, unless a question bank still uses it - so a tag rarely has to be deleted by hand, and a tag removed that way is gone for good (re-adding creates a new one with a new id). Returns the tag plus all remaining tags of the Riddle, and with UUIDs the {bulk, operation, summary, results} envelope with one entry per Riddle, a failure reported as that entry's "error" without stopping the others. Only if the Riddle's origin.writableByThisKey is true (riddle_get, riddle_list): riddle://reference/concepts/access.

UUID.description: The UUID of the single Riddle to untag. Pass either this or UUIDs.

UUIDs.description: Several Riddles to untag at once, as Riddle UUID strings, e.g. ["6FA740EW", "OllsevHa"] (max 100). Pass either this or UUID.

tagId.description: The ID of an existing tag, as returned by riddle_tag_list. Pass either this or tagName.

tagName.description: The name of the tag. Nothing is ever created; a name the Riddle's project does not have is an error. Pass either this or tagId.

name: riddle_tag_remove
